adversary_classes.name: Classical adversary
adversary_classes.mitigation: AES-256 / symmetric cipher on key channel

adversary_classes.name: Quantum adversary (future QC)
adversary_classes.capability: Run Shor's algorithm on RSA/ECC keys
adversary_classes.attack_surface: Asymmetric wrapper on key delivery channel

adversary_classes.name: Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later adversary
adversary_classes.capability: Long-lived quantum memory + classical channel access
adversary_classes.attack_surface: Classical key channel at any time T₂ > T₁
adversary_classes.mitigation: PQC-KEM + ephemeral forward secrecy on key delivery
adversary_classes.residual_risk: None if forward secrecy is enforced

adversary_classes.name: Malicious quantum cloud (ransomware)
adversary_classes.capability: Full control of quantum compute/storage infrastructure
adversary_classes.attack_surface: Alice's raw qubit BEFORE local U_enc
adversary_classes.mitigation: Perform U_enc locally; never transmit unencrypted qubits
adversary_classes.residual_risk: None if local-first encryption is enforced

result.invariant: The quantum channel carrying S_i is ALWAYS unconditionally secure. The attack surface is EXCLUSIVELY the classical key delivery channel. Total system security = security of classical key channel.
actionable_summary: Deploy PQC-KEM (ML-KEM) for all key delivery channels NOW.
Enforce ephemeral forward secrecy (ECDHE + PQC hybrid) on key sessions.
Never transmit raw qubits to untrusted quantum cloud providers.
Perform U_enc locally before any external quantum transmission.
Audit classical channel infrastructure — it is your only attack surface.
